title: AirFM-DDA: Air-Interface Foundation Model in the Delay-Doppler-Angle Domain for AI-Native 6G
abstract: arXiv:2605.00020v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The success of large foundation models is catalyzing a new paradigm for AI-native 6G network design: wireless foundation models for physical-layer design. However, existing models often operate on channel state information (CSI) in the spatial-temporal-frequency (STF) domain, where multipath components are superimposed and structurally entangled. This hinders the learning of a universal channel representation. Their reliance on global attention also incurs prohibitive overhead. In this paper, we propose AirFM-DDA, an Air-interface Foundation Model in the Delay-Doppler-Angle (DDA) domain. AirFM-DDA reparameterizes CSI into the DDA domain to resolve multipath components along physically meaningful axes and employs window-based attention with frame-structure-aware positional encoding. translated_title: AirFM-DDA：面向AI原生6G的时延-多普勒-角度域空口基础模型
translated_abstract: 大型基础模型的成功正在催生AI原生6G网络设计的新范式：面向物理层设计的无线基础模型。然而，现有模型通常在空间-时间-频率（STF）域的信道状态信息（CSI）上运行，其中多径分量相互叠加且在结构上纠缠在一起，这阻碍了通用信道表示的学习。此外，它们对全局注意力的依赖也带来了难以承受的开销。在本文中，我们提出了AirFM-DDA，一种工作在时延-多普勒-角度（DDA）域的空口基础模型。AirFM-DDA将CSI重新参数化到DDA域，以沿着具有物理意义的轴分离多径分量，并采用基于窗口的注意力机制以及帧结构感知的位置编码。大量实验证明了该模型在场景、任务、数据集和天线配置之间的可迁移性。在信道预测和估计……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AirFM-DDA，通过将信道状态信息重参数化到物理意义明确的时延-多普勒-角度域，并结合窗口注意力与帧结构感知位置编码，构建了可跨场景、任务、数据集和天线配置迁移的空口基础模型，为AI原生6G物理层设计开辟了新范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AirFM-DDA, an air-interface foundation model that reparameterizes CSI into the physically meaningful Delay-Doppler-Angle domain with window-based attention and frame-structure-aware positional encoding, achieving transferability across scenarios, tasks, datasets, and antenna configurations for AI-native 6G physical-layer design.
